verdict.rationale: The evidence shows separately licensed Bitbucket Server and Data Center editions exist (a 'Data Center license' and migration from Server/Data Center), which implies a self-managed deployment of the core product. However, it never documents self-hosting directly, and all mentions frame these editions as something to migrate away from to Cloud. Private CI runners are an adjacent feature and earn no credit. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Server/Data Center can be installed and run on your own infrastructure, installation/deployment docs, confirmation the self-hosted edition is still offered and supported, feature parity (e.g. AI features) with Cloud, independent or hands-on corroboration.
